description: This Java test class contains unit tests for the ConnectionLogUtil utility, focusing on logging enhancements related to connection and correlation IDs within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: ConnectionLogUtilTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing log enhancement utilities in ConnectionLogUtil.

methods.name: beforeClass
methods.description: Initializes the default MDC map with predefined key-value pairs before any tests are run.

methods.description: Sets up the mock DiagnosticLoggingAdapter and its MDC for each test.
